<?php
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$envFile = '/home/iebi.rg.telkomuniversity.ac.id/laravel_apps/master_data/.env';
if (!file_exists($envFile)) {
    echo json_encode(['status' => 0, 'error' => '.env not found', 'checked' => $envFile]);
    exit;
}
$env = parse_ini_file($envFile, false, INI_SCANNER_RAW);
$appRoot = '/home/iebi.rg.telkomuniversity.ac.id/public_html/master_data';
try {
    $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;port=%s;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4', $env['DB_HOST'] ?? '127.0.0.1', $env['DB_PORT'] ?? '3306', $env['DB_DATABASE'] ?? '');
    $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $env['DB_USERNAME'] ?? '', $env['DB_PASSWORD'] ?? '', [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
    $rows = $pdo->query('SELECT id, nama_dosen, foto_path FROM profils ORDER BY id LIMIT 20')->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    foreach ($rows as &$r) {
        $foto = (string) ($r['foto_path'] ?? '');
        $r['exists_storage'] = $foto !== '' ? file_exists($appRoot . '/storage/' . $foto) : false;
        $r['exists_storage_app_public'] = $foto !== '' ? file_exists($appRoot . '/storage/app/public/' . $foto) : false;
        $r['url_candidate'] = $foto !== '' ? '/master_data/storage/' . ltrim($foto, '/') : null;
    }
    unset($r);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 1, 'rows' => $rows], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo json_encode(['status' => 0, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
}
